_about: The Events page at /toronto/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page. 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source. 'shows' (November 15, 2026) adds the big venues' concerts, games and shows from the Venues listing (docs/<city>/venues/shows.json) with a switch at the top; its title, intro, desc and card replace the words'.

words.title: What’s on in Toronto
words.intro: Every event on the City of Toronto’s Festivals & Events Calendar and every Toronto Public Library branch program, for the next 30 days.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to the source, nothing else.
words.desc: What’s on in Toronto today, this weekend and this week: the City’s Festivals & Events Calendar and Toronto Public Library branch programs, with free events marked.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next 30 days
words.source: Events from the City of Toronto Festivals & Events Calendar (as the organizers list them) and Toronto Public Library branch programs. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.

shows.title: What’s on in Toronto
shows.intro: Concerts, games and shows at the big venues across the GTA, plus every event on the City of Toronto’s Festivals & Events Calendar and every Toronto Public Library branch program, for the next 30 days.
shows.desc: What’s on in Toronto today, this weekend and this week: concerts, games and shows at the big venues, the City’s Festivals & Events Calendar and Toronto Public Library programs, with free events marked.
shows.card: Big venues, community events, the next 30 days
shows.source: Shows at the big venues from Ticketmaster.
